programmes.d: Find out if the 600LT is quicker than Porsche 911 GT3. Then, 2017's evo Car of the Year sets a lap time.
Dickie Meaden and Steve Sutcliffe race each other in i30 Ns. Then, explore the fascinating Col de Turini.
An Alfa Romeo battles the thunderous Mercedes AMG C 63. And Henry Catchpole reviews the Boxster Spyder.
Ride across Europe in the spacious Ferrari FF. Then, have a ton of fun in the Ariel Nomad.
Dive into the devilish details of the McLaren F1. Then, witness the Audi S1 launch near the Arctic Circle.

Brothers Jacob and Paul’s 1965 Chevy Impala nicknamed the Night Prowler would have been better named the Night Slug. Don shows up with a 1967 Corvette and a massive list of work that he wants done. Dan doesn’t know which is worse: the list, or the car.

When Ovide purchased his 1957 Bel Air sight unseen, the car was a rusted piece of junk so it’s on Dan to figure out how to restore this classic. Dino loves to go fast. His 1969 Super Bee is anything but super. Dan is tasked to feed Dino’s need for speed.

Nick bought his wife Danielle a 1953 Chevy Pickup for her 28th birthday. The couple wants a perfect FantomWorks restoration. The truck has other ideas. Eric’s rare 1939 LaSalle is a sight to behold, but it hasn’t seen a wrench in eighty years.

Mike thought his 1967 Chevy K10 Pick Up needed paint improvement. Dan quickly realizes that the car needs much more. Nobody restores 1970 Opel Kadett, so there are no parts anywhere for Harry’s car that needs a lot of everything.

Ron and Valerie want Dan to restore their 1963 Jeep Willy’s Fleetvan, but the problems run deeper than the seams hidden beneath inches of filler. Grady’s Z28 breaks down so often that he’s never had it out of second gear.

John thinks his 1958 Corvette is ‘mostly original’ but Dan finds a mismatched assortment of poor-quality parts and bad repairs. Chelsea wants FantomWorks to fix up a rare 1971 Fury for her father, Rikk. The car has previously caught on fire 3 times!

Tom and Patti want to drive their 1967 Amphicar on land and water, but the hybrid boat-car has problems from stem to stern. Doc Pellerin hasn’t started his ultra-rare Austin 10/4 in years. He needs Dan to get it running for a major car show in four days.

Daniel wants FantomWorks to swap out the V6 of his 1968 Mustang Convertible with the V8 from a donor car. Stacia and Eugenia need Dan’s help to transform their quirky 1962 Citroen 2CV from a ‘problem child’ to a reliable car.
Ryan, Mike and Shannon convince Danny to sponsor them in a 24-hour junk car endurance race. Meanwhile Danny has the guys work on a one of a kind special shop project as payback for his sponsorship.

The guys finally find a not so perfect car for the junk car race which they resurrect as the "Count's Bloody Mess." At the race, they realize first place may not be an option, but hope that "Count's Bloody Mess" will finish in one piece.

Twisted Sister's Dee Snider brings the crew a brand new BMW Z4 that he wants Count-ified for his wife Suzette as an anniversary present. A simple paint job turns disaster when Suzette is not happy with the final look, not once, but twice.
Kevin's brother Steve wants a 1980 Kawasaki KZ100 motorcycle tricked out just like the ones on the classic TV series, CHiPs.

Ryan and Kevin find a 1972 Datsun 240z that Danny agrees to flip. But when he has a last-minute change of heart, Ryan must figure out how to make Danny's vision a reality without derailing the project.
Danny and Shannon are in motorcycle heaven when they are asked to restore a rare 1957 Harley Davidson Pan head prototype that has spent the last 20 years in their client's living room.

The local Fox News channel wants to update their Ford Expedition Storm Chaser in a mobile news unit with an elaborate paint scheme that they can also bring to schools to help kids learn about weather.

After the vehicle that holds a land speed record is seriously damaged and repaired, the guys give it a sleek look. Then, the crew heads to Bonneville, UT to watch the Turbinator go for the record again.
Ryan and Kevin head to the Bonneville Salt Flats to see The Turbinator, a vehicle that holds a land speed record try to break 500 MPH.
When a client rolls into Count's Kustoms with a beautiful 1955 Chevy Nomad, Danny can't help but want the car for his collection.

Lonnie, one of the shop's long time painters, wants to give his Lincoln lowrider a new, but simple, paint job. Meanwhile, Mike and Paul find a Rolls Royce that used to belong to Donny and Marie Osmond.

When the World Series of Poker guys want a Count's Kustoms chopper as the ultimate online giveaway, Danny is determined to make it something special. Meanwhile, Mike and Ryan check go for a spin in a 1957 Bel Air.
The evo team tests 16 stunning cars to decide which contenders will make it to the finale. Part 1 of 2.
With eight cars remaining, the evo team explores the Scottish Borders for the final reckoning. Part 2 of 2.
Steve drives four different courses to reveal how to get the most out of the BMW performance car.
Take the ultimate pilgrimage for the performance car enthusiast. Then, the i30 N excels in northern Scotland.
The McLaren is in for the fight of its life on the track against a 911 GT3. Then, a battle of Porsches.
Harry Metcalfe guides us through the history of the Lamborghini V12.
Get a taste of the revolutionary 155-mph i8 hybrid car. Then, an unfair track battle.
Jethro Bovingdon compares the F12 to the 599 GTO. Then, the M4 gets a true test.
Henry Catchpole introduces us to McLaren's first Sports Series supercar. Then, an R8 GT Spyder at Silverstone.
Explore a new kind of electrified Mustang. Then, similar cars compete in the fun column.
Join Harry Metcalfe on the amazing three-day Lamborghini 50th anniversary tour.
Get a look at some stunning cars at the Quail show at the Pebble Beach weekend. Then, April fools.
Join Harry Metcalfe in a convertible Bentley in snowy Spain. Then, put a Lambo through its paces in Italy.
Harry Metcalfe drives a super-rare hypercar. Then, the greatest driving road in the world.
Take the 1244-bhp Hennessey Venom GT on the road. Then, the legendary Lancia Delta Integrale Evo II.
Dive into the P1's clever aerodynamic and cooling features. Then, see if it's faster than an RXC Turbo 500.
Drive a replica of the iconic Silverstone Circuit cut into a frozen lake. Then, meet the Vauxhall Maloo.
Which hot hatch will be faster around the super-quick Rockingham circuit? Then, the Cayman GT4 hits the track.
Get under the skin of McLaren's special 789-bhp track car.
Head to Italy to drive the mighty Pagani Huayra and get a taste of the Veyron Vitesse. Then, a proper Ferrari?
Jethro investigates whether or not Ferrari has created another masterpiece. Then, an epic road trip.
